hypotheses: B lower reference/dummy supply voltage with preserved dummy compliance
protocol.selection: DC gate first, then 1.6 Gb/s; adjacent higher-rate point only after success. Freeze candidate before holdout. Keep failures. No tuning against holdout.
protocol.scope: Schematic transistor simulation, same public PDK and synthetic load; no new layout/PEX, startup, PVT or hardware qualification. Seven source-port energy, upstream converter/RX/clock excluded.
protocol.holdout_scope: Different PRBS15 window; not statistically independent random BER qualification

limitations: Schematic transistor simulation; new physical layout, DRC, LVS and PEX not completed.
Synthetic 20um load and 200ps optical/1GHz RX held fixed; no device bandwidth claim.
Failed-case pJ denominates attempted payload, not successfully transmitted useful bits.
No random noise, measured BER, startup/disable, PVT or production qualification.
Positive seven-port supply energy reported; returned energy is separately retained and no perfect converter recovery is assumed.
